snippets.title: Validate schemas and examples with the repository scripts
snippets.code:
git clone https://github.com/agentic-commerce-protocol/agentic-commerce-protocol.git
cd agentic-commerce-protocol
pnpm install
# compile every JSON Schema in every dated folder
pnpm run validate:json-schema
# check examples against the schemas
pnpm run validate:all
snippets.note: Script names are the ones in package.json. Run your own request bodies through the same schemas before you ship.

snippets.title: Verify a Merchant-Signature order webhook (agent platform)
snippets.sdk: Node.js node:crypto (implements the ACP webhook signature rule)
snippets.note: Written for this atlas from the signature rule in the webhook OpenAPI file (HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp, a dot and the raw body; 300-second tolerance). Uses only Node.js built-ins; answer 401 when it returns false.
